meta.name: add-resend
meta.description: Add Resend (email) channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 集成 Resend 邮件发送通道到聊天应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在聊天应用中添加邮件发送能力
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Resend email channel into your chat app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add email sending to a chat application

howto.what: 装上后，Claude可以通过Resend邮件通道异步接收和回复电子邮件，实现与用户的邮件对话。
howto.when: 当用户完成凭证设置、域名验证和webhook配置后，向绑定的邮箱地址发送邮件时触发。

say.text: 请帮我设置邮箱地址为 owner@example.com
say.note: Claude会执行所有者注册并发送hello邮件。
Claude通过Resend发送邮件到你的地址。

say.text: 检查邮件通道是否工作

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can asynchronously receive and reply to emails via the Resend channel, enabling email conversations with users.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a user sends an email to the configured email address after completing credential setup, domain verification, and webhook configuration.

say_en.text: Please set my email address to owner@example.com
say_en.note: Claude will register the owner and send a hello email.
Claude sends an email to your address via Resend.

say_en.text: Check if the email channel is working
say_en.note: Claude runs tests and reports the result.
